findings.explanation: Both wrong options simply negate explicit prompt facts: B says equal display and publicity although the prompt assigns main display and most publicity to factory goods; C says handmade stalls are closed although the prompt says they remain. A learner can select A by spotting direct contradictions without deciding what figurative pushed aside means.
findings.recommendedRepair: Replace B/C with plausible contextual near-misses: one may overgeneralize the fair’s visibility loss to every market; another may incorrectly infer that retaining a stall guarantees unchanged prominence. Keep each option unambiguously unsupported and align English, Chinese and explanation.
